name: ClipCascade
description: Automatically sync your clipboard across multiple devices, no key press required. Ensures seamless clipboard sharing between devices, prioritizing privacy with end-to-end encryption. See documentation for set-up details: https://github.com/Sathvik-Rao/ClipCascade

variables.name: Database - Driver
variables.description: The database driver. Default uses H2 file mode. Example for PostgreSQL: org.postgresql.Driverset

variables.name: Database - Dialect
variables.description: The database dialect. Default uses H2 file mode. Example for PostgreSQL: org.hibernate.dialect.PostgreSQLDialect

variables.name: Database - URL
variables.description: The database URL. Default uses H2 file mode. Example for PostgreSQL: jdbc:postgresql://localhost:5432/clipcascade

variables.name: Database - Username
variables.description: The database username. Default uses H2 file mode. Once set, you must use the same username whenever you migrate the database.

variables.name: Database - Password
variables.description: Sets a password for encrypting the user database. Once set, you must use the same password whenever you migrate the database. Pattern: FILE_PASSWORD USER_PASSWORD

variables.name: Allow Signups
variables.description: Toggle to enable or disable the signup feature/page for public users.

variables.name: Max Accounts
variables.description: Sets the maximum number of user accounts that can be created on the server. Set to -1 for unlimited.

variables.name: Enable Donations
variables.description: Enables or disables the donations feature.

variables.name: External Broker - Enable
variables.description: Enables or disables the external STOMP broker feature for P2S mode.

variables.name: External Broker - Host
variables.description: The external STOMP broker URL for P2S mode.

variables.name: External Broker - Port
variables.description: The external STOMP broker port for P2S mode.

variables.name: External Broker - Username
variables.description: The external STOMP broker username for P2S mode.

variables.name: External Broker - Password
variables.description: The external STOMP broker password for P2S mode.

variables.name: Inactive Account Purge Time
variables.description: Purge/delete inactive accounts after a specified number of seconds. Set to -1 to disable this feature.

variables.name: Max Message Size
variables.description: Maximum message size, in bytes. Recommend less than 25 for desktop, approx. 1 for mobile

variables.name: Enable Peer-To-Peer
variables.description: This feature decrease the load on the server and allows unlimited data transfer. If enabled, the Max Message Size value is ignored. NOTE: Some networks may not support Peer-to-Peer.

variables.name: P2P STUN URL
variables.description: STUN server URL for Peer-to-Peer connections. Required if P2P is enabled. Only change if you know what this is.

variables.name: Allowed Origins
variables.description: Specifies which domains are allowed to connect to the WebSocket (CORS policy). Replace with your domain. If not set, all origins are allowed by default, which may be less secure.

variables.name: Session Timeout
variables.description: Sets the session timeout duration.

variables.name: Brute Force Protection - Max Unique IPs
variables.description: The maximum number of attempts from different IP addresses before an account is blocked for a given timeout.

variables.name: Brute Force Protection - Max Attempts Per IP
variables.description: The maximum number of attempts per IP address before blocking the IP address for a given timeout and will scale if continued.

variables.name: Brute Force Protection - Timeout
variables.description: The lockout timeout for failed login attempts.

variables.name: Brute Force Protection - Timeout Scaling
variables.description: The scaling factor for the lockout timeout. Determines how the lockout duration increases with each repeated failed attempt.

variables.name: Brute Force Protection - Tracker Cache
variables.description: Enables or disables caching for the BFA tracker. If enabled, the server caches BFA tracker data in memory and disk.

variables.name: Brute Force Protection - Tracker Cache Max Entries
variables.description: The maximum number of entries in the BFA tracker cache (JVM RAM).

variables.name: Brute Force Protection - Tracker Cache RAM Percentage
variables.description: The percentage of the BFA tracker cache allocated to off-heap RAM.

variables.name: Brute Force Protection - Tracker Cache Disk Percentage
variables.description: The percentage of the BFA tracker cache allocated to disk storage.

variables.name: Brute Force Protection - Tracker Logging
variables.description: Enables or disables logging of the BFA tracker.

variables.name: Logging Level
variables.description: Sets the logging level for the server.

variables.name: Log Retention
variables.description: The maximum number of days to retain server logs.

variables.name: Log Capacity
variables.description: The maximum capacity of server logs.

variables.name: Internal Server Port
variables.description: Internal port for the server. Not recommended to change.
